_about: The owner's decisions on single products, applied after the automatic rules. Keyed by the product's address on the live shop. Empty until the owner decides something: the build then proposes, flags and imports as draft. Fields: "skip": true with a "reason" (do not import); "name"; "sku"; "price" (whole rupees) or "price": "on-request"; "compareAt" (whole rupees, or null to drop it); "category" (a key of categories.json); "id" (a different address for the new shop); "decidedBy" and "decidedOn" for the record.
